alt: 戶外展覽忽然下雨，學生靈機一動用展示板遮住紙模型，夥伴趕緊把作品移到屋簷下。
scene_prompt: Modern school outdoor science fair: sudden light rain starts, student calmly and quickly turns a large display board into an umbrella-like cover over the group's paper model while teammate moves project to dry shelter; show practical quick adjustment, no panic. Natural anatomy, secure grip, rain direction consistent, grounded feet.
